exists_original_descended_chart (i : Fin 5) (τ : HalfPlane)
    (hp : PELUnlevelledComplexBase318.projection τ∈fixedLocus i) :
    ∃ U : Set UnlevelledBase,PELUnlevelledComplexBase318.projection τ∈U ∧
      IsOpen (PELOriginalMaximalQuotient318.projection '' U) ∧
      IsOpen (squaredCoordinate τ '' U) ∧
      ∃ e : (PELOriginalMaximalQuotient318.projection '' U) ≃ₜ (squaredCoordinate τ '' U),
        ∀ x (hx : x∈U),
          (e ⟨PELOriginalMaximalQuotient318.projection x,⟨x,hx,rfl⟩⟩:ℂ)=squaredCoordinate τ x

evaluatedPoint_action (f:G→+*ᵍ G) (hf:G₊≤G₊.map f)
    (φ:P→+*S) (j k:Fin 2) (hj:IsUnit (φ (X j))) (hk:IsUnit (φ (f (X k)))) :
    evaluatedPoint φ j hj ≫ Proj.map f hf =
      evaluatedPoint (φ.comp f.toRingHom) k hk

coeff_one_subst (F P:k⟦X⟧) (hF:F.constantCoeff=0) :
    coeff 1 (P.subst F)=coeff 1 P*coeff 1 F

sigma_constant (F P:k⟦X⟧) (hF:F.constantCoeff=0) :
    constantCoeff (sigma F hF P)=constantCoeff P
